card.name: Legal case and verdict wording
card.fires_on: Small words such as against, a, in, or a comma in legal text about lawsuits, juries, verdicts and settlements, right before the case, verdict or charge term.

modes.label: Lawsuit and verdict phrasing
modes.description: Linking words just before a case, verdict or deadlock is named.
modes.example: You may also have a case<< against>> the manufacturer of the asbestos product involved.

modes.label: Jury and court lists
modes.description: Commas or words inside lists of litigation areas or court outcomes.
modes.example: complex civil litigation in antitrust<<,>> securities, intellectual property, and product liability

modes.label: Settlement or guilt wording
modes.description: Words before a guilty finding or a payment amount.
modes.example: 142 of the 185 defendants were<< found>> guilty of at least one of the charges

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated and mixed.
